downmatica.gui.config.title: Configuration
downmatica.config.comment.openDownloadIn: Pressing the bound hotkey will open the download interface of Downmatica.
downmatica.config.comment.openConfigInte: Pressing the bound hotkey will open the configuration interface of Downmatica.
downmatica.config.comment.litematicaMain:
Add a button in the main menu of Litematica. Click this button to enter the download interface of Downmatica.
§cThe Litematica mod needs to be installed for this function.
downmatica.config.comment.downloadToSche:
When downloading the schematic, the dialog box for selecting a folder will not pop up, but it will be downloaded directly to the schematic base directory.
§cThe Litematica mod needs to be installed for this function.
downmatica.config.comment.downloadOverla: If there is a file with the same name when downloading the schematic, the file will be overwritten directly.
downmatica.config.comment.totalTimeout:
The timeout for getting schematic list, in milliseconds.
-1 indicates no timeout.
downmatica.config.comment.httpTimeout:
The timeout of the HTTP request. The unit is millisecond.
-1 indicates no timeout.
downmatica.config.comment.enableHttp2:
Enable HTTP/2 protocol for network requests.
§6When enabled, the request speed may be increased. If the server does not support it, it will be downgraded to HTTP/1.1.
downmatica.config.comment.redirectPolicy:
Sets the processing method when HTTP requests encounter redirection.

Normal: Only follow the protocol redirection (e.g. HTTPS → HTTPS).
Always: Follow all redirects.
Never: Do not follow any redirects.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.downmatic: It is convenient for you to download the schematic from the network.
